name: TR-300 Machine Report
install: for p in repos/qube-machine-report/.cursor/install.sh qube-machine-report/.cursor/install.sh .cursor/install.sh /agent/repos/qube-machine-report/.cursor/install.sh; do if [ -f "$p" ]; then bash "$p"; exit $?; fi; done; echo 'TR-300 install.sh not found' >&2; exit 1

terminals.name: homepage-dev
terminals.description: Vite dev server for the sibling marketing homepage on http://127.0.0.1:5173/. Prints a message and idles when the homepage repo is not checked out.
terminals.command: for d in repos/qube-machine-report-homepage qube-machine-report-homepage ../qube-machine-report-homepage /agent/repos/qube-machine-report-homepage; do if [ -f "$d/package.json" ]; then cd "$d" && exec npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173; fi; done; echo '[homepage-dev] qube-machine-report-homepage not checked out; nothing to serve.'
